latestVersion.changelog:
Long Task Handler V2 – Enhanced long task management with smarter feedback and error transparency.

- Introduces dual-phase feedback: quick pre-task estimation and regular progress updates during execution
- Adds intelligent time estimation based on task type and data volume
- Provides clear, quantifiable progress metrics (e.g., step X/Y, percentage complete)
- Upgrades error handling: proactively reports problems with status, notifies on long silence
- Activates automatically for compile, deploy, training, large data tasks, or on user request
- Configures reporting intervals, auto-archiving, and concurrent task limits for better control
